---

# Netshare

> Fast, private file sharing on your local network.

Netshare lets you instantly share files between devices on the same network — no cloud, no account, no internet required.

## See how NetShare works

Watch the short demo to see how to move files between devices on the same network without cloud links, shared-folder setup, or internet dependency.

Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KIReSrqF8FI

## Share files on the same network, without relying on the Internet

Netshare is a free, open-source app for secure local network file sharing. It helps you transfer files between devices on the same network, share files between two computers, or between a computer and a mobile device.

### Local-first & blazing fast

Files move directly between devices on your local network, making Netshare a fast option for transferring files between computers, mobile-computer, and mobile-mobile on the same network.

### Privacy by design

Your data stays on your network. No uploads, no tracking, and no external servers involved when you securely share files over your local network.

### Works without internet

Share files without relying on the internet. Netshare works in offline or restricted environments such as offices, labs, factories, and internal networks.

### Cross-platform

Share files between two computers or between a computer and a mobile device across Android, iOS, and macOS on the same network.

## Large file transfers in action

See NetShare move large files between an Android phone and a macOS desktop over the local network, with no cloud upload in between.

Large file transfer demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yhZNjhfu0R4

## Built for real-world environments

Designed for LAN-first sharing in secure, offline, and policy-restricted networks.

### Internal enterprise

Share files within the company when cloud tools are restricted or blocked.

- No Google Drive or external links required
- Perfect for HR docs, source code, and design files

### Factories & industrial sites

Built for isolated networks where devices may have no Internet access.

- Works on internal networks
- Reliable transfers in offline environments

### Schools, labs & hospitals

Keep sensitive data on-premises while still enabling fast collaboration.

- Designed for LAN-only setups
- Supports privacy-first workflows

### Dev teams & studios

Move large builds and assets quickly between machines on the same LAN.

- Share builds, exports, and media assets
- Avoid cloud upload time and bandwidth costs

## Technology

Built with Flutter for a consistent cross-platform app. Flutter helped the team move quickly across platforms while keeping the UI consistent. It was chosen to enable fast development without maintaining separate native apps.

More: https://netfshare.site/technology/

## Download for macOS

---
title: "Download for macOS - Netshare"
description: "Download Netshare for macOS as a notarized DMG, or get it from the Mac App Store."
url: "https://netfshare.site/download-macos/"
---

# Download Netshare for Mac

Get the notarized DMG for direct install, or install from the Mac App Store.

## Download

- DMG URL file: https://netfshare.site/assets/downloads/macos-dmg.url (points at Cloudflare Worker gate over private R2; not a public r2.dev URL)
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/id6758239332

## How to install from the DMG

1. Open the downloaded NetShare.dmg file.
2. Drag NetShare into the Applications folder.
3. Open NetShare from Applications (or Launchpad).

The DMG is Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple, so Gatekeeper should accept it without extra steps.

*This is a markdown version of [https://netfshare.site/download-macos/](https://netfshare.site/download-macos/) for AI/LLM consumption.*

## Privacy Policy

---
title: "Privacy Policy - Netshare"
description: "Privacy Policy for Netshare application."
url: "https://netfshare.site/privacy/"

# Privacy Policy

**Last updated:** May 18, 2026

Netshare respects your privacy and is designed with privacy as a core principle.

## 1. Data Collection

Netshare does not collect, store, or transmit the files you share to any external servers.

The application operates primarily within your local network and does not require user accounts or cloud services.

## 2. File Transfers

All file transfers occur directly between devices on the same network.

Transferred data is not routed through third-party servers operated by Netshare.

## 3. Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Google Ads

Netshare uses Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics to understand app usage, monitor stability, and diagnose failures. Depending on how the app is used and configured, these services may process information such as app-instance identifiers, session and usage statistics, approximate geolocation, device and app information, stack traces, relevant app state, and device metadata associated with crashes or errors. Netshare uses this information only to monitor performance, investigate bugs and crashes, and improve app quality. It is used only for app analytics, diagnostics, and stability improvement.

Netshare may also use Google Ads services to display and measure ads in the app. Depending on configuration, these services may process data such as device and app information, identifiers, approximate location, ad-interaction data, and performance information to support ad delivery, fraud prevention, and measurement. Where required, ad-related processing is subject to applicable user consent and platform privacy settings.

**Note:** Firebase, Crashlytics, and Google Ads are integrated only in official app-store builds, not in the open-source project source code.

## 4. Internet Access

Internet access is not required for core local file-transfer functionality.

If optional online features are introduced in the future, they will be clearly disclosed and governed by updated policies.

## 5. Security

We take reasonable measures to ensure secure communication between devices within the local network.

However, users are responsible for ensuring the security of their own network environments.

## 6. Changes to This Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time.

Any changes will be published on this page with an updated revision date.

## 7. Terms of Use (EULA)

NetShare uses Apple's Standard End User License Agreement for apps distributed through the App Store. By downloading or using NetShare from the App Store, your use of the app is also governed by Apple's standard licensed application terms, unless NetShare provides a separate written agreement that applies to your use.

You can review the Apple Standard EULA at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

## 8. Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: netshare.oss@gmail.com

*This is a markdown version of [https://netfshare.site/privacy/](https://netfshare.site/privacy/) for AI/LLM consumption.*
